command: cat <claude-projects-dir> | jq '.items[] | select(.kind != "Pod") | {kind: .kind, name: .metadata.name, configMaps: (.. | select(has("configMapRef")?)? | .configMapRef.name)}'

kubectl get deployments,statefulsets,daemonsets,jobs,cronjobs -n wiki-b01a -o json | jq -r '.items[] | {kind: .kind, name: .metadata.name, configMaps: [.. | objects | select(has("configMapRef")) | .configMapRef.name]} | select(.configMaps | length > 0)'
kubectl get all -n wiki-b01a -o yaml | grep -i configMapRef
kubectl get deployment wikiweb -n wiki-b01a -o yaml | grep -A 2 "configMapRef\|configMap:" | grep "name:"
kubectl get deployment wikiweb -n wiki-b01a -o json
kubectl delete configmap import-rules page-templates-2023 -n wiki-b01a
